## MCP - Tenant - Resolve v2.0

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/mcp-tenant-resolve

**Description:** Resolves Discord guild_id to tenant_id + package + models (RFC-079).

**InputSchema:**
```json
{
  "action": "resolve",
  "user_id": "string (optionnel)",
  "guild_id": "string (requis)",
  "backend_api_url": "string",
  "backend_service_token": "string"
}
```

**Returns (RFC-079):**
```json
{
  "data": {
    "tenant_id": "Z6F3GSWB",
    "package": {
      "code": "mid-complet",
      "source": "discord_guild_default",
      "models": {
        "chat": "claude-sonnet-4-5",
        "chat_mini": "claude-haiku-4-5",
        "embedding": "text-embedding-3-large",
        "vision": null,
        "voice": null,
        "reasoning": null
      }
    }
  }
}
```

**RFC:** RFC-079 Tenant Package Configuration
